description: The bar chart illustrates the Token Ratio (TR) performance of three models—RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)—across six evaluation categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The vertical axis represents the TR value, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with 0.1 intervals. In each category, three bars are displayed side-by-side, corresponding to the three models, with colors indicating their respective identities as defined in the legend. SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 consistently achieves a perfect score of 1.00 in all six categories, indicating superior performance. RedWhale shows varying performance, with its highest TR value of approximately 0.73 in KoBEST-SN and its lowest of 0.42 in PT-EVAL. EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 exhibits a declining trend across the categories, starting at 0.46 in PT-EVAL, peaking at 0.74 in KoBEST-CP, and reaching its lowest at 0.50 in KoBEST-HS. In the AVG category, RedWhale achieves a mean TR of 0.61, slightly higher than EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0’s 0.57, while both models fall significantly short of the base model’s performance.
